+"""SQLite persistence for users."""
+
+import sqlite3
+
+_conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:", check_same_thread=False)
+_conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
+_conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE)")
+_conn.executemany("INSERT INTO users (id, name, email) VALUES (?, ?, ?)", [
+    (1, "Ada Lovelace", "ada@example.com"),
+    (2, "Linus Torvalds", "linus@example.com"),
+    (3, "Grace Hopper", "grace@example.com"),
+])
+_conn.commit()
+
+
+def _to_dict(row):
+    return dict(row) if row else None
+
+
+def get_by_id(user_id: int) -> dict | None:
+    return _to_dict(_conn.execute("SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE id = ?", (user_id,)).fetchone())
+
+
+def find_by_email(email: str) -> dict | None:
+    return _to_dict(_conn.execute("SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE email = ?", (email,)).fetchone())
+
+
+def list_all() -> list[dict]:
+    rows = _conn.execute("SELECT id, name, email FROM users ORDER BY id").fetchall()
+    return [dict(row) for row in rows]

+def search_users(terms: list[str]) -> list[dict]:
+    """Return users whose name contains every term as a literal, case-insensitive substring."""
+    results = []
+    for user in store.list_all():
+        name = user["name"].lower()
+        if all(term.lower() in name for term in terms):
+            results.append(user)
+    return results

+"""Request handlers."""
+
+from app.services import users
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def handle_search_terms(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    terms = params.get("terms")
+    if not isinstance(terms, list) or not terms or len(terms) > 5:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid terms"}
+    cleaned = []
+    for term in terms:
+        if not isinstance(term, str):
+            return 400, {"error": "invalid terms"}
+        stripped = term.strip()
+        if not stripped or len(stripped) > 30:
+            return 400, {"error": "invalid terms"}
+        cleaned.append(stripped)
+    return 200, {"users": users.search_users(cleaned)}

from app.api.handlers import handle_search_terms as h

def check(params, expected):
    got = h(params)
    status = "OK " if got == expected else "FAIL"
    print(status, params, "->", got, "expected", expected)

# valid: every term must appear
check({"terms": ["a"]}, (200, {"users": [
    {"id": 1, "name": "Ada Lovelace", "email": "ada@example.com"},
    {"id": 2, "name": "Linus Torvalds", "email": "linus@example.com"},
    {"id": 3, "name": "Grace Hopper", "email": "grace@example.com"},
]}))
check({"terms": ["ada"]}, (200, {"users": [{"id": 1, "name": "Ada Lovelace", "email": "ada@example.com"}]}))
check({"terms": ["a", "hopper"]}, (200, {"users": [{"id": 3, "name": "Grace Hopper", "email": "grace@example.com"}]}))
# trimming
check({"terms": ["  ada  "]}, (200, {"users": [{"id": 1, "name": "Ada Lovelace", "email": "ada@example.com"}]}))
# case-insensitive
check({"terms": ["LOVE"]}, (200, {"users": [{"id": 1, "name": "Ada Lovelace", "email": "ada@example.com"}]}))
# literal % and _
check({"terms": ["%"]}, (200, {"users": []}))
check({"terms": ["_"]}, (200, {"users": []}))
check({"terms": ["a%a"]}, (200, {"users": []}))
# no match
check({"terms": ["zzz"]}, (200, {"users": []}))
# missing / not list / empty / too many
check({}, (400, {"error": "invalid terms"}))
check({"terms": "ada"}, (400, {"error": "invalid terms"}))
check({"terms": []}, (400, {"error": "invalid terms"}))
check({"terms": ["a"]*6}, (400, {"error": "invalid terms"}))
# bad items
check({"terms": ["ada", 5]}, (400, {"error": "invalid terms"}))
check({"terms": ["   "]}, (400, {"error": "invalid terms"}))
check({"terms": ["x"*31]}, (400, {"error": "invalid terms"}))
check({"terms": ["x"*30]}, (200, {"users": []}))
# exactly 5 terms
check({"terms": ["a","d","a","l","o"]}, (200, {"users": [{"id": 1, "name": "Ada Lovelace", "email": "ada@example.com"}]}))
